steps.what: Confer with coaches about protective equipment needs and sporting conditions
Assess and select protective equipment within the trainer's scope

tasks.design: Keep consultation and equipment suitability judgement with the trainer and coach. Existing specifications in {DOCS} support the choice; no separate catalogue-copying or ordering share is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: Suitability depends on the sport, athlete and actual equipment characteristics.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes reduced time for the stated selection interaction.
tasks.still_hard: Nominally suitable equipment may not fit the athlete or the intended activity.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize when a generic specification fails to address the real protective need.
tasks.altitude: Equipment advice and selection scope remain unchanged.

reach.task: Assess functional constraints relevant to equipment use
reach.learn: When a physical limitation needs specialist assessment

evidence.claim: Protective equipment selection requires contextual consultation and suitability assessment; clinical documentation tools do not establish a reduction in this task.

assumptions: Boundary is consultation and selection, excluding procurement, clinical diagnosis and physical equipment modification. Coach participation remains unchanged outside focal time.

Coaches and athletes supply requirements during s1 before s2 selection. Suppliers supply specifications before selection; the trainer verifies applicability and fit information within retained time. No free suitable-equipment flag is assumed.
Native specification access precedes custom code. No new service or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Local trainer scope and equipment selection requirements
research_questions: Which equipment decisions require direct fit assessment or specialist referral?

approvals.approved_version: Exact athlete context, sport, equipment specification, fit conditions and selection communicated; changed conditions require reassessment.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Consultation and suitability judgement retain their time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess performance goals, athlete circumstances and constraints before developing training programs
Develop training programs or routines suited to the assessed goals and constraints

tasks.design: Retain assessment and training design with the trainer. {DOCS} holds the program, but no separate routine transcription share or verified automatic program-selection capability is established.
tasks.previous_blocker: A program must fit the athlete's condition and response rather than only a general goal.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes reduced time for individualized program judgement under this boundary.
tasks.still_hard: Appropriateness and progression may only become clear through later response.
tasks.human_edge: Balance performance aims with individual limitations and recognize when specialist guidance is needed.
tasks.altitude: Program design responsibility and clinical boundaries remain unchanged.

reach.task: Review the rationale for a conditioning program
reach.learn: How performance evidence constrains progression choices

evidence.claim: Individualized training design remains contextual judgement; no separate clerical layout baseline or validated automatic program design is established here.

assumptions: Boundary is program development, excluding delivery, later response monitoring and specialist clinical assessment. Those actions retain their own effort.

Athletes supply goals and current circumstances during s1; clinicians supply relevant guidance before s1 where applicable. The trainer verifies restrictions and captures requirements within its 40 hours, then selects activities and progression in s2. No free medically-cleared or appropriate-routine flag is assumed.
Native program templates precede custom code if repetitive formatting is later measured. No new service or transferred work is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Existing templates and actual repetitive formatting effort
research_questions: Can necessary program judgement be distinguished from any repeated document layout work?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. No document-production share is invented within individualized program design.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Lead stretching exercises for team members prior to games or practices

tasks.design: Keep demonstration, observation and correction with the trainer. Existing guidance in {DOCS} supports execution; session contact time is not treated as paperwork.
tasks.previous_blocker: The trainer must observe how participants perform and respond.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in physical session leadership.
tasks.still_hard: Participants may need different correction or may report discomfort during the session.
tasks.human_edge: Notice individual responses and adapt within the trainer's scope.

reach.learn: How to distinguish coaching correction from a clinical concern

evidence.claim: Leading and observing physical exercises retains human presence; no independent administrative saving is established.

assumptions: Boundary is session leadership, excluding program development in 4229 and later clinical evaluation. Participant exercise effort stays outside focal time unchanged.

Coaches supply session context before s1; participants supply current responses during s1 before correction or adaptation. The trainer checks relevant restrictions and observes execution within its full time; no free ready-to-exercise flag is assumed.
Native guidance access precedes code. No new service or upkeep is proposed; incremental hours are zero.
research_questions: Which participant responses require direct observation rather than a prerecorded demonstration?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Physical contact and supervision retain all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research or teach athletic training topics

steps.what: Review source evidence for instruction on athletic training or sports medicine
Provide instruction on subject matter related to athletic training or sports medicine

tasks.design: For the instruction branch, retain source evaluation in {DOCS} and responsive teaching with the trainer. This task does not establish a repeated evidence-review pipeline or material-formatting share to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching needs current evidence and an understanding of the learner's questions.
tasks.enabler_now: No new capability establishes a reduction in source judgement or live instruction.
tasks.still_hard: General evidence can be misapplied to a specific athlete or teaching example.
tasks.human_edge: Explain evidence limits and recognize a learner's misunderstanding.

reach.task: Explain limits of sports medicine evidence
reach.learn: When an educational question requires clinical expertise

evidence.claim: The instruction branch requires evidence evaluation and responsive teaching; no supported administrative time reduction is established by the digest's documentation capabilities.

assumptions: Boundary is the instruction branch, excluding new original research, clinical advice and separate consultation documentation. A research-only case needs a different decomposition and is not assigned teaching savings.

Source authors produce literature before s1; the trainer verifies version, scope and relevance within its 30 hours. Learners produce questions during s2 before understanding is clarified. No structured correct-lesson or competent-learner flag is assumed.
Native source retrieval precedes code if a repeated search burden is measured. No new service or work transfer is proposed, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current evidence sources and teaching scope
research_questions: Is there a measurable repeated search or formatting operation separate from evidence evaluation and instruction?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100, gross=0, upkeep=0 and net=0. Source evaluation and live teaching retain their full shares.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Equipment consultation, individualized programs, physical session leadership and instruction retain human time under these boundaries.
reach: Clarify movement referral boundaries with a physical therapist
Review conditioning rationale with an exercise physiologist
role.ambitious_version: A trainer who protects direct athlete support and makes the limits of equipment, program and educational advice clear.
